summary: DRV-204: `selection subframe restore` fails deterministically: after guiding with `AGENT_GUIDER_SELECTION.SUBFRAME` set, aborting leaves `CCD_FRAME.WIDTH` at the subframe width (400) instead of restoring the full frame (1600), so the camera stays subframed after the agent stops. Reproduce with `build/integration/test_agent_guider "selection subframe restore"`. Verified pre-existing: it reproduces with `indigo_libs/` reverted to `6c28c23c6`, before this session's changes. Agents were outside the requested sweep, so it is recorded rather than fixed. Next: revalidate historical evidence and assign a scoped repair task; no risk acceptance or closure is implied.
